limits: Two separate qualification jobs preceded the eight application attempts; their allocation is outside the application ledger.
First cache fill is inside the measured boundary; setup, imports, model loading, warmup and numerical validation are outside it.
Randomly initialized CNN and generated repeated input; numerical agreement does not establish classifier accuracy.
Per-phase wall time includes launch, synchronization and instrumentation overhead; not CUDA kernel busy time or utilization.
No causal inference for arbitrary workloads, asynchronous pipelines, training or real storage/network bottlenecks.
No net operational saving claimed: allocation, queue, setup and qualification costs exceed these millisecond compute savings.
